item.title: Reading Corner Title I Program Information
item.description:
Reading Corner is Kramer's Title I Reading program that provides small-group reading instruction to K-3 students who need extra literacy support. Students receive 30 minutes of daily instruction from Mrs. Geshan, Mrs. Kobermann, and Mrs. Walters, focusing on letter naming, phonemic awareness, phonics, vocabulary, fluency, and comprehension. All K-3 students are assessed at the beginning of the year and again in December to determine eligibility, and students are released when they consistently meet grade-level benchmarks. Contact instructors at geshanc@talawanda.org, kobermanc@talawanda.org, or waltersh@talawanda.org with questions.

item.title: No Toy Policy Begins September 14th
item.description:
Kramer Elementary (note: this appears to be mislabeled as a high school item) will implement a no toy policy starting Monday, September 14th. Students should leave toys and other non-school-related items at home to keep classrooms focused, safe, and free from distractions. Prohibited items include gaming devices, headphones, trading cards, fidget spinners, and sports equipment. Exceptions will be made for medical conditions supported by a note from a medical provider.

item.title: Reading Corner Title I Reading Program Introduction
item.description:
Reading Corner (Title I Reading) provides small-group reading instruction to qualified K-3 students for 30 minutes daily. Students are assessed at the beginning of the school year and again in December to determine eligibility. Students are released from the program when they consistently meet grade level benchmarks. Contact: geshanc@talawanda.org, kobermanc@talawanda.org, or waltersh@talawanda.org

item.title: New Peachjar Digital Flyer System Launched
item.description:
Talawanda School District is launching Peachjar, a digital flyer management system for the 2026-2027 school year that replaces paper handouts with electronic delivery. Parents automatically receive a weekly digest email of school-approved flyers if their email is on file—no registration needed. Flyers can also be viewed via the Peachjar button on the school website, and parents can opt out or adjust email frequency at any time.

item.title: PAX Good Behavior Program Information
item.description:
PAX Vision is a school-wide behavior program that helps set clear expectations for student conduct. PAX refers to anything that adds to Peace, Productivity, Health, and Happiness, while Spleems are behaviors that detract from these values.

The program teaches students to: - See More smiling, Hear More nice words, Do More taking turns, and Feel More happy - See Less running, Hear Less shouting, Do Less interrupting, and Feel Less nervous

Parents can engage by asking their child: What did everyone want more of in PAX Vision today? What PAX things did you and friends do well? What Spleems is everyone still working on?

item.title: Volunteer and Visitor Policy Requirements
item.description:
All adult volunteers must have a volunteer application on file each school year. After a second visit or before chaperoning/assisting with field trips, volunteers must complete fingerprinting and background check through the Central Registration Office at least 3 weeks prior to the event. Background checks are valid for 5 years. Contact Ruth Michael at 513-273-3101 for Central Registration.

item.title: Kramer Free Pantry for Students
item.description:
A free food and hygiene pantry is located at the entrance of Kramer, available to all students. The pantry contains cereal, fruit, vegetables, peanut butter, spaghetti, mac and cheese, soup, shampoo, and toothbrushes. For questions, donations, or suggestions, contact Chelsea Pike, Kramer Social Worker at 513-273-3511 or pikec@talawanda.org.

item.title: 2026-2027 School Calendar Released
item.description:
The complete 2026-2027 school calendar for Talawanda Schools is now available. The calendar includes 170 school days, 4 teacher work days, 3 data collaboration days, 2 conference exchange days, and 3 professional development days, totaling 182 days. Key dates include: - First Day for K-12 Students: August 24, 2026 - Winter Break: December 21, 2026 - January 1, 2027 - Spring Break: March 15-19, 2027 - Last Day of School: June 27, 2027

Major breaks include Thanksgiving Break (November 25-27, 2026), conferences, and various professional development and teacher work days throughout the year.
